verdict.rationale: Insomnia documents natural-language input for one feature: generating a mock server from a prompt plus a URL, OpenAPI, or JSON input. AI commit message suggestions are assistance, not commands, and the MCP client connects external servers rather than letting users drive Insomnia itself in natural language. missing for 10: general natural-language operation of the app (creating or sending requests, running tests, managing collections or environments via prompts), any conversational assistant or command interface, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Auto-generate a mock server from a natural language prompt and one of the following input types: URL, OpenAPI, or JSON.
Creates a mock server from a prompt, OpenAPI definition, or live URL response. Automatically scaffolds routes, responses, and configurations.
AI-assisted mock server generation, which transforms prompts or API definitions into mock APIs.
